channel.title: ProdBuilds blog
channel.description: Engineering write-ups from ProdBuilds, with tested code and measured results.

item.title: Why your Spring Boot @Scheduled job runs twice (and what actually stops it)
item.description: Add a second instance and every @Scheduled job runs twice. We counted the duplicates across six setups: ShedLock fixes it, but only with two settings that are easy to get wrong.

item.title: The case of the vanishing JobRunr runs
item.description: Spring, Quartz and JobRunr ran the same job every minute, and JobRunr quietly lost a run. The log line that gave it away, the gap behind it and the 5.2.0 fix.

item.title: Going, going, gone: closing Firebase auctions on time
item.description: Bids pile up in the last seconds, and a once-a-minute sweep closes auctions late. The pattern we recommend: the deadline in the bid transaction, one Cloud Task per auction and an idempotent close.
